summary.answer: If marker falsy do nothing. Else obtain container width,height, compass corners x0,y0,x1,y1, compass-north x,y and marker width,height. If abs(northX)>0, horizontal=(position.y-y0)/(y1-y0)*containerWidth and vertical=(position.x-x0)/(x1-x0)*containerHeight. Else if abs(northY)>0, horizontal uses position.x/x range and width; vertical uses position.y/y range and height. Subtract half marker width/height, then setLeftRight(0,0,left,left+markerWidth) followed by setTopBottom(0,0,top,top+markerHeight). No explicit return. Call getobjectiveposition(controller,objectiveId) for x,y,z. Only if all three results are truthy call the selected same-file PositionMarker(container,controller,marker,{x=x,y=y,z=z}). Otherwise do nothing. Return implicitly nil. Numeric zero remains truthy under ordinary Lua; no independent marker check is added here. If SpawnSelectionLabel is nil do nothing. Otherwise eva [excerpt; exact source record identified separately]
